name: Isabella: Chasing Shadows
source:
Recovering from the death of your fiancé, you find that the accident that claimed her life was not a mere accident… in your investigation, you’ll meet a high fashion model who can bring you one step closer to learning the truth of why your fiancé was murdered… and the criminal ring behind it and their plans.

Will you be able to stop this seedy conspiracy? Are you looking for Justice or Revenge? And will you be able to find love again as you use every means at your disposal to avenge your deceased fiancé?
